description: Every ImmyBot endpoint typed, plus a local mirror that joins what the web UI keeps per tenant.

novel_features.name: Session triage
novel_features.description: Group the last window's failed maintenance actions by normalized root cause instead of reading the same error on forty machines.

novel_features.name: Version spread
novel_features.description: Semver-ordered distribution of one software title across every tenant, flagging everything below a floor.

novel_features.name: Fleet diff
novel_features.description: What changed between two syncs: computers added or removed, software versions moved, assignments modified. Record a baseline with --snapshot after a sync, then compare with --since.

novel_features.name: Onboarding stalled
novel_features.description: Computers stuck waiting to onboard, bucketed by age and annotated with whether onboarding was ever attempted.

novel_features.name: Assignment explain
novel_features.description: Show every target assignment that resolves onto one computer, which scope matched, and which rules are shadowed.

novel_features.name: Script blast radius
novel_features.description: Every maintenance task, software package and computer that a script reaches before you edit it.

novel_features.name: PSA reconcile
novel_features.description: Diff the ImmyBot roster against a linked PSA or RMM asset roster to find unlinked computers and orphaned assets.

novel_features.name: Deployment health
novel_features.description: Historical success rate per deployment, including ones that never worked.

novel_features.name: Drift
novel_features.description: Per-tenant compliance posture across every software title, ranked by how far installed versions trail the newest version seen in the fleet.

novel_features.name: Computer dossier
novel_features.description: Identity, tenant, installed software and recent maintenance history for one computer, assembled from the local mirror in one pass.

novel_features.name: Schedule orphans
novel_features.description: Maintenance schedules whose target, tenant or target type no longer exists, plus disabled schedules, from the local mirror.

novel_features.name: Provider link health
novel_features.description: Every RMM or PSA provider link that is disabled, unhealthy or reporting a sync failure, with the failure messages ImmyBot recorded.
